description: Run the AI-DLC `refined-mockups` stage (inception phase) in isolation, without advancing the main workflow. Packages `/aidlc --stage refined-mockups --single`: the engine emits one run-stage directive for refined-mockups and its gate, the conductor runs it, then the single-stage run commits a synthetic-id pair and stops. The main workflow's Current Stage is never touched.
